indications.indication: Leber Congenital Amaurosis 5 (LCA5)-associated inherited retinal degeneration
indications.trial_name: Phase 1/2 (UPenn-led); planned Phase 3 single-arm 8-participant adaptive trial
indications.trial_design: Open-label, dose-escalation, subretinal injection; 6 late-stage participants treated (3 adult, 3 pediatric); planned Phase 3 with run-in natural history
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING; positive 18-month adult and 3-month pediatric data Sep 2025; FDA Type B RMAT meeting Nov 2025; RDEP application targeted Q1 2026; Phase 3 dosing 2H 2026

indications.indication: BEST1-associated retinal disease (Best Vitelliform Macular Dystrophy and Autosomal Recessive Bestrophinopathy)
indications.trial_design: Adaptive, open-label, dose-exploring safety/tolerability; single subretinal injection in one eye; two dosing cohorts

pipeline.modality: Small molecule alpha-1/alpha-2 adrenergic antagonist eye drop
pipeline.license_origin: Opus/Ocuphire; commercialized for mydriasis by Viatris

indications.trial_design: Multicenter, randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled Phase 3; VEGA-3 enrolled 569 participants 3:2 PS vs placebo, once daily evening dosing
indications.trial_status: Both pivotal Phase 3 trials met primary endpoints (VEGA-2 Nov 2023; VEGA-3 Jun 2025); sNDA filed by Viatris
key_milestones: sNDA filed by Viatris based on both Phase 3 trials

indications.indication: Decreased vision under dim light after keratorefractive surgery (LYNX program)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 double-masked, randomized, placebo-controlled multicenter (LYNX-2 met primary endpoint; LYNX-3 ongoing)
indications.trial_status: LYNX-2 met primary endpoint Jun 2025; LYNX-3 first patient dosed Sep 2025; topline 1H 2026

pipeline.modality: Oral small-molecule selective Ref-1 (APE1/Ref-1) redox inhibitor

indications.highest_phase: Phase 2 completed; Phase 3 SPA in place; partnering being sought
indications.trial_design: Phase 2b ZETA-1 randomized double-masked placebo-controlled in 103 DR/DME patients (did not meet primary endpoint in study eye, supportive binocular data)
indications.trial_status: Phase 3 design under SPA agreed Dec 2024; Opus seeking strategic partner to advance program (deprioritized internally)

commercial_product.name: RYZUMVI (phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75%)
commercial_product.note: Same molecule as PS; Opus receives milestones/royalties under Viatris License Agreement
